$comment: GET /v2/spaces/{spaceId} -- verified against the Meet API v2 Discovery Document 2026-09-16. Reads a space's CURRENT state, including whether a conference is live right now (activeConference) -- the field a host polls to learn a meeting has started.
title: Get meeting space
description: Read a Meet space's current state, including whether a conference is active right now.

config.label: Space ID
config.description: The id from space_create's data.name (spaces/{id} -- give the id after the slash), or the meeting code shown in Meet's own UI. NOT independently spot-checked that the meeting-code form resolves through this exact endpoint; verify with a live call before relying on it.

outputShape.description: Present only while a conference is LIVE right now — the conferenceRecords/{id} resource name to read once it ends. Absent between meetings.
